|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per turn, if [[Skyhook Platform]] on table and opponent just forfeited a character present with your slaver, may 'enslave' that character (stack character face down under Skyhook Platform). May place an 'enslaved' character in owner's Lost Pile to activate up to 3 Force. Once per turn, while [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire{{!}}Indentured To The Empire]] on table, may cancel a Force drain by placing here from hand any non-unique slaver. Slavers may deploy from here as if from hand. May not be canceled. (Immune to [[Alter (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Alter]].)
